2609.38504.title: An Empirical Study of Architectural Shift from Traditional to AI-Enabled Simulink Controllers
2609.38504.paper_summary: Effective AI adoption in cyber-physical systems (CPS) depends on embedding design knowledge into engineering practice. Yet as AI-enabled components increasingly replace analytically derived control laws, this occurs without a systematic understanding of how controller architectures differ or remain similar across paradigms. We address this gap with an empirical study of traditional and AI-enabled Simulink controllers, guided by a literature-derived taxonomy of ten structural categories and nine functional roles. The study analyzes 62 real-world models spanning 8 controller types and 10 application domains, and surveys 13 practitioners, identifying three architectural tensions. First, subsystem organization dominates all controller structures regardless of paradigm, occupying 68-72% of controller footprint, while core control logic occupies minimal space. Second, AI-enabled controllers rely heavily on discrete dynamics and user-defined abstraction, categories largely absent from AI literature, exposing a gap between described and implemented architectures. Third, constraint enforcement blocks largely disappear from AI-enabled models despite practitioner expectations. This reveals a misalignment where safety mechanisms shift from explicit structure to implicit training-time artifacts, breaking traceability.
2609.38504.paper_summary_zh: 有效的人工智慧在網路物理系統（CPS）中的應用依賴於將設計知識嵌入工程實踐中。<lb/>然而，隨著人工智慧驅動的元件越來越多地取代分析推導的控制法則，這一過程並未系統性地理解控制器架構在不同範式之間的差異或相似之處。<lb/>我們通過一項實證研究來填補這一空白，研究傳統和人工智慧驅動的Simulink控制器，並以文獻衍生的十個結構類別和九個功能角色的分類法為指導。<lb/>該研究分析了62個涵蓋8種控制器類型和10個應用領域的真實模型，並調查了13位從業者，識別出三個架構緊張點。<lb/>首先，子系統組織主導所有控制器結構，無論範式如何，佔據了68-72%的控制器佔地面積，而核心控制邏輯佔據的空間則非常有限。<lb/>其次，人工智慧驅動的控制器在很大程度上依賴於離散動態和用戶定義的抽象，這些類別在人工智慧文獻中幾乎不存在，揭示了描述與實施架構之間的差距。<lb/>第三，儘管從業者有預期，約束執行塊在人工智慧驅動的模型中幾乎消失。<lb/>這揭示了一種不一致，安全機制從明確的結構轉變為隱含的訓練時間工件，打破了可追溯性。
